scenes.line: Every legal answer starts with research. Every research answer has to be checked. Precedent writes the memo, and shows you why it's right.
Multi-agent systems fail four ways. Agents collide. Output goes unverified. Side effects escape. And nothing leaves a trace. Precedent answers all four.
Ask in plain language. You get a short answer, the authorities behind it, and a caveat when the sources don't support one.
Every citation resolves to a real jurisdiction, pinned on the map, so you can see whether a claim rests on one line of cases, or on many.
The safeguard rejects any authority that was never retrieved. Quotes are copied verbatim. Nothing is beyond inspection.
Four agents run every question. Planner, retriever, writer, safeguard. Every step traced, timed, and scored in Arize Phoenix.
Seven partners, one pipeline. Daytona, SurrealDB, Octo, Arize, ElevenLabs, Anthropic, and ACS.
Precedent. Verified research memos for legal teams. Ask your own question.
